science_vegetable: Magnetohydrodynamic Kelvin-Helmholtz shear across the ferrofluid sea

active_location.macro_silhouette: The tempest-tossed ferrofluid sea heaves against the basalt shoreline, driven by unseen magnetic tides. Jagged fractal waves of metallic black liquid crest and shatter into magnetic mist under the dual suns. The air itself feels thick with conductive tension, crackling softly as the Kelvin-Helmholtz shear tears across the horizon.

sensory_palette.sight_and_color: Metallic black waves, silver mist, dual sun glare.
sensory_palette.sound: Deafening metallic crashing and static crackle.
sensory_palette.tactile_temperature: Biting wind with a strange static warmth.

interactive_features.affordance_description: Can be used to brace against the incoming magnetic waves.
Pulls loose metallic objects toward it with immense force.
Rapidly swallows anything stepping onto the unstable magnetic crust.

reactive_toys.motivation_goal: To equalize magnetic pressure by tearing across the shoreline.
reactive_toys.consistent_method: Generating cascading waves of ferrofluid spikes.
reactive_toys.immediate_complication: Threatens to swamp the induction rigging Hector is working on.
reactive_toys.uninterrupted_escalation: Will rip the rigging entirely from its mountings, setting back the project.

three_levels_of_why.level_1_immediate: Hector must secure the rigging before the shear vortex hits.
three_levels_of_why.level_2_local: The induction equipment is vital for tracking the ferrofluid sea's shifting tides.
three_levels_of_why.level_3_campaign_arc: Understanding the sea's anomalies is key to stabilizing the Enclave's power grid.

judge_tactician.failure_stakes_declared: If Hector fails, the rigging is swamped, setting back the grid stabilization.

graduated_outcomes.nat_1_false_intuition: Hector misjudges the shear's vector entirely, taking the full brunt of the static discharge.
graduated_outcomes.below_dc_complicated_fail_forward: Hector secures the rigging but shorts out his own insulated gloves in the process.
graduated_outcomes.meets_dc_clean_success: Hector deftly anchors the shunt, avoiding the ferrofluid spikes entirely.
graduated_outcomes.dc_plus_5_or_20_extended_lore: Hector not only secures the rigging but realizes the shear's frequency matches the induction core's resonance.

master_narrator.agency_handoff_prompt: Hector swung his torque wrench wildly, nearly dropping it into the surging metallic black waves of the ferrofluid sea. The magnetohydrodynamic Kelvin-Helmholtz shear tore through the air, sending static shocks up his arms. He barely managed to lock the induction shunt into place before the fractal breakwater collapsed under a massive magnetic swell. Panting, his insulated boots smoking slightly, Hector scrambled up the basalt shoreline and nearly collided with Kaio. 'You see that?' Hector shouted over the deafening crackle, thrusting the sparking telemetry baton directly into Kaio's hands. 'The shear is shifting!' Kaio caught the baton, his eyes wide with boundlessly curious wonder as he examined the glowing readings.
